turns.question: Between 17 August and 10 October 2026, how much higher in EUR was the average non-cancelled order amount of customers who signed up before 2026 than that of customers who signed up in 2026?
turns.answer: Customers who signed up before 2026 averaged 102.67 EUR per non-cancelled order, against 41.00 EUR for customers who signed up in 2026, so the gap is 61.67 EUR (the difference of the two returned figures), for orders placed 17 August to 10 October 2026.
